title: URBAN OASIS stylish, private, 4m to downtown
description:
Beautiful & private well equipped apartment on ground  level of Victorian house in the trendy walkable Urbandale Nations area- 10 min. Uber to downtown. Short walk to great eateries and hangouts. Enjoy your morning coffee on the cozy front porch bistro area or evening drinks in the back outdoor sitting area with lounge chairs. On a quiet tree lined street w free parking . Cozy BR w comfy Queen bed,  stainless full kitchen, electric fireplace, WiFi , 43” smart TV-  Close to everything Nashville!

The space
Your lovely apartment is a brand new renovation in a charming Victorian apartment house.  You have privacy, with no indoor shared spaces. Free Onsite parking, wifi and TV  for hookup to your Amazon Prime and Netflix.  If you are looking for privacy and charm, you found it!  You have your own bedroom,  kitchen, bathroom and  living room. The apartment easily sleeps 4- two in the comfy Queen size bed in the bedroom- and Queen air bed

Guest access
Entire private apartment, front porch with bistro area, back yard sitting area with cool anti-gravity lounge chairs  for star gazing and memory making!

Other things to note
Beautiful property, in the heart of trendy The Nations. Urban walkable area. Close eateries, 10 min Uber ride to the excitement of downtown “NashVegas”, while situated on a quiet well kept street for your retreat from the hustle and bustle. 
Charming as heck! 
Lighted pathway to help you navigate from your Uber or car  to the front door!

I am a musician and actress with homes in Nashville and the New York Metropolitan area.  I host a lovely apartment in my updated Victorian home in the trendy Urbandale Nations area of Nashville  for other AIRBNB travelers.  I have lived and performed in many places including Winnipeg, MB and Toronto, ON, CANADA; Chicago, Ill;  Naples, Florida; and Nashville ,TN :-)  I love to travel and see new places and meet new people, and I am proud to say that I have visited every US State, and Canadian province.  The Cayman Islands and Palm Beach Shores , Florida  are my two top chill destinations, although I'm also partial to Spain, and hope to get back there soon.
I love great movies, indie film, all music ,  great food AND wonderful people.  Life is too short not to enjoy it!! I believe all our dreams are within reach. Yes, eternally optimistic!
